name: Kind words
description: Thirty gentle lines for "A moment for you": no hustle, just a little warmth.

thoughts.text: You don't have to finish everything today to have done enough.
Small steps still move you forward.
Be as patient with yourself as you are with a friend.
Rest is not a reward. It's part of the plan.
One thing at a time is still a lot of things.
It's okay to start again in the middle of the day.
Notice one thing that went right this morning.
Your pace is allowed to be your own.
Drink some water. Unclench your jaw. Carry on.
Progress is often quiet.
Being kind to yourself makes the work better, not softer.
A messy first try is still a first try.
You've handled hard days before.
Leave a little room in the day for nothing at all.
Good enough, done, is better than perfect, waiting.
Look out of a window for a moment.
Ask for help early. It saves everyone time.
Curiosity is a good place to work from.
Today counts, even if it's an ordinary one.
You can change your mind when you learn something new.
Close one tab you don't need.
Celebrate the boring wins too.
Breathe out a little longer than you breathe in.
The plan can bend without breaking.
Somebody is glad you're around.
Feeling tired is information, not a verdict.
Write down one thing so your head can let go of it.
Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
The best time to take a break is a little before you need one.
Well begun is half done.
thoughts.author: Aristotle
